stem: Why did the U.S. government take this action during the Great Depression?

options.label: A
options.text: Some thought people of Mexican ancestry were buying too much property.

options.label: B
options.text: Some thought people of Mexican ancestry were taking jobs from U.S. workers.

options.label: C
options.text: Some feared that people of Mexican ancestry would force U.S. schools to teach foreign languages.

options.label: D
options.text: Some feared that people of Mexican ancestry would force their religious beliefs to become the law of the land.

visual_elements: Box containing excerpt from Kevin R. Johnson, 'The Forgotten Repatriation of Persons of Mexican Ancestry and Lessons for the War on Terror,' Pace Law Review, Fall 2005
